The weighted campus energy balance calculator passed all verification tests with a perfect reward score in the initial iteration.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 with zero exceptions across all trials. Pytest 8.4.1 successfully validated the logic in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. While the current implementation is stable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weighting factors to ensure the energy balance remains physically consistent.
